name: disposition-claim
body: The writer's response to the single feedback item it was dispatched: a claim of ACTIONED (the issue was fixed) or WONT-FIX (with justification), returned to the coordinator. It is a claim, not a state transition — the writer holds no feedback-action capability, so the claim is evaluated by the coordinator and the item's state is moved by the coordinator (action) and the reviewer (terminal resolve/reject). The claim's consistency with the observed change is what the coordinator's shallow check measures.
